reasoning: This is a command-line interface (CLI) tool, not an operator, library, service, or configuration repo. It builds a Go binary named `kubectl-odh` (a kubectl plugin) for interacting with RHOAI/ODH deployments on Kubernetes. It uses cobra for command dispatch and provides subcommands including lint, status, diagnose, migrate, backup, components, events, logs, deps, get, mcp, and version. The binary is distributed as a container image and as a standalone executable. It connects to Kubernetes clusters via kubeconfig to inspect and manage RHOAI installations.
